sloka: राघवश्च महावीर्यः क्षिप्रं त्वामभिपत्स्यते ।समित्रबान्धवं हत्वा रावणं राक्षसाधिपम् ।। ५.३५.७९।।।।
transliteration: rāghavaśca mahāvīryaḥ kṣipraṁ tvāmabhipatsyate ।samitrabāndhavaṁ hatvā rāvaṇaṁ rākṣasādhipam ।। 5.35.79।।।।

translations.english: "Mighty Raghava will take you after killing Ravana, the king of demons along with his kith and kin.
